scope.question: Composition of the S50 pre-escrow Kpre_3 and S51 escrow/API Kpost_3 views under exogenous SuccessFence versus actual finite-timeout success selection.
scope.function: signed Q20.12 descending, stable original-index ascending ties, original-order Top-K XOR mask shares with exactly K ones
scope.input_security_scope: Kpre_3 proof applies only to 1<=K<=N<=256; S48/S52 N<=1000 evidence is finite functional evidence only.

S52_SOURCE_RECEIPT.evidence: Exact S52 commit/tree/parent verified. 9/9 Git blobs in S52 delivery manifest match; canonical_delivery SHA recomputed from recorded raw rows matches. Two Markdown worktree raw hashes differ due core.autocrlf=true, while Git blobs match.

TIMEOUT_SOURCE_INVENTORY.evidence: Reviewed fixed S52 transport, Select5, escrow and party source paths. Per-frame and transaction wait boundaries, visible API states, blocking DNS/TCP connect and accept, and absence of one global call deadline are mapped in S53 report section 4. This is source review, not deployment measurement.

IDEAL_SUCCESSFENCE_KPRE3_KPOST3_COMPOSIT.evidence: Inherited S50/S51 application-message composition under ideal IID FTv3, cap_success, ideal A token RNG, one static semi-honest party, trusted non-colluding T/A, causal honest-peer deposit and an exogenous environment guaranteeing endpoint availability and every required operation before its deadline. Does not include actual timing, timeout selection, availability or finite-timeout sampling.

ACTUAL_FINITE_TIMEOUT_SUCCESS_CONDITIONE.gap: No deployment scheduler/network/OS/TLS/DB delay model and no permission-correct sampler/proof for Law(Vpre_b | Q_b, cap_success, S_actual) approximately Law(Vpre_b | Q_b, cap_success), for b=0,1.

SUCCESS_SELECTION_NONDEPENDENCE.gap: No evidence that w(v)=Pr[S_actual | Vpre_b=v,Q_b,cap_success] is constant or negligibly varying. Publicly determined successful message shape does not establish secret-independent processing/scheduling delay.

L_S29_TIME_OR_STATUS_EXPANSION.evidence: Time, timeout, activity shape and new states were not appended to L_S29.

S52_LISTED_FUNCTIONAL_RECEIPT.evidence: S52's seven API-v2/escrow state cases and eight listed N=1000/compatibility cases are inherited only; S53 did not rerun them. Not full-domain correctness, security or performance.

NATURAL_BUSINESS_IO_FAULT.evidence: Inherited S52 classification. Explicit server timeout, callback failures and missing-row actions were TEST_ONLY injections; no natural business read/write fault was observed. S53 did not run runtime tests.

LOW_PROBABILITY_ISSUANCE_ABORT_ACCEPTANC.evidence: No new explicit owner decision is present in the fixed S52 evidence.

REAL_FT_DEALER_DRBG_SIGNATURE_BRIDGE.evidence: Not addressed by S53; inherited deployment and implementation bridge gaps remain.

A_TOKEN_RNG_BRIDGE.evidence: Ideal token RNG assumption only; real service RNG bridge not established.

TLS_MTLS_RECIPIENT_CRYPTO_HASH_BINDING.evidence: Source timeout inventory does not prove deployment cryptographic advantages or recipient-encryption/hash composition.

COMPLETE_GMW_SELECT_SHUFFLE_OUTPUT_ESCRO.evidence: Only inherited scoped Kpre_3/Kpost_3 subclaims; complete real-deployment party-view composition remains open.

N_GT_256_SECURITY.evidence: Kpre_3 theorem scope is N<=256. N=1000 is finite inherited functional evidence only.

BUILD_TEST.evidence: Documentation/source review only; no runtime code changed.

FORMAL_LAN_WAN_RTT_AAV86_PERFORMANCE.evidence: No formal network or performance experiments were run.

SECURE_ALIAS_READY.evidence: No secure alias created; full security gates remain open.
